name: com.basis.integration.sso
description: Client-side OIDC single sign-on for the BasisVR Desktop/PCVR client. Gates app launch behind an Authorization Code + PKCE login (Okta and generic OIDC), persists the session encrypted-at-rest, and binds the local DID identity to the signed-in user. Server/DID protocol is unchanged. See docs/sso-spec.md.
